pages.text: Hold the quenched ingot and right-click the grindstone: the same bar, two passes. Get both clean and you have a $(item)Tempered Iron Ingot$(). Miss either and it comes out an $(item)Unstable Ingot$(): grind it again, cleanly, or it breaks.
pages.title: Grinding

pages.text: The finished metal. Its stars say how many times it's been through the forge.
pages.title: Tempered Iron
